# RULER subset (vendored, official generators only)

Source: https://github.com/hsiehjackson/RULER
Commit: `c3f5e3b4f87f97e048793bb510a3a6b19a46bf3a` (cloned 2026-08-07, depth 1)
License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`)

The files under `scripts/data/` are copied verbatim from the official
RULER repository's data generators (`prepare.py`-side modules and task
scripts) and `scripts/eval/synthetic/constants.py` (official scoring
metrics). No task template, generator, or metric was modified.

## Subset design (documented deviation)

`ruler_subset.yaml` defines noise-haystack variants of the official
RULER tasks, generated by the *same* official task scripts with the
official templates from `scripts/data/synthetic/constants.py`:

| task | official task | haystack | params |
|---|---|---|---|
| ruler_niah_single | niah | noise | k=1 v=1 q=1, words/numbers |
| ruler_niah_multikey | niah | noise | k=4 v=1 q=1, words/numbers |
| ruler_niah_multivalue | niah | noise | k=1 v=4 q=1, words/numbers |
| ruler_niah_multiquery | niah | noise | k=1 v=1 q=4, words/numbers |
| ruler_vt | variable_tracking | noise | chains=1 hops=4 |
| ruler_cwe | common_words_extraction | — | freq_cw=30 freq_ucw=3 num_cw=10 |
| ruler_fwe | freq_words_extraction | — | alpha=2.0 |

The official default NIAH haystacks use Paul Graham essays
(`type_haystack: essay`); we use `noise` so data generation is fully
self-contained and does not depend on a third-party corpus download.
Scoring uses the official `string_match_all` metric.

Lengths: 4096 and 8192 tokens (`max_seq_length` includes generated
tokens). Samples per task per length: 20 (official RULER uses 500;
this is a disclosed subset for ablation).

## Orchestration

- `scripts/eval/ruler_prepare.py` generates datasets by invoking the
  official task scripts with the exact command construction used by the
  official `prepare.py`.
- `scripts/eval/ruler_quality.py` runs vLLM offline greedy generation
  per (task, length, allocation) cell and scores with the official metric.
